title: New law: A joint resolution designating the week commencing January 28, 1973, as "International Clergy Week in the United States", and for other purposes. (Public Law 93-2)
summary: H.J.Res. 163 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-2 on 1973-01-26.

title: New law: A joint resolution extending the time within which the President may transmit the Budget Message and the Economic Report to the Congress and extending the time within which the Joint Economic Committee shall file its report. (Public Law 93-1)
summary: H.J.Res. 1 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-1 on 1973-01-19.
